summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Growth ETF (LGDS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of US large-cap growth stocks. The ETF uses data science techniques to select stocks based on fundamental criteria for long-term growth. LGDS was launched on Jul 10, 2026 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.

holdings.infoBox: LGDS is an equity ETF with a total of 103 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 16.44%, Alphabet at 10.97%, Apple at 7.28%, Microsoft at 5.09%, and Broadcom at 4.50%.
